result.reason: The redline does not establish the required mutual cap: IBM’s cap is increased to the greater of USD 1,000,000 or 12 months’ fees paid or payable, while Customer’s remains the greater of USD 100,000 or fees paid. The Excluded Claims language generally includes the preferred carve-outs, and the payment provision remains outside the limitations, but “foregoing limitations” is insufficiently precise as to which caps and exclusions are disapplied. The new IBM exclusion for third-party claims is an unnecessary substantive change not required by the playbook. The clause also contains duplicative numbering and an incomplete parenthetical, so it is not professionally drafted.
